title: UE-requested PDU session release procedure initiation

entities.name: UE-requested PDU session release procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the UE to release a PDU session. The UE sends a PDU SESSION RELEASE REQUEST message and starts timer T3582.

entities.name: PDU SESSION RELEASE REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by the UE to initiate PDU session release. Contains PTI IE and optionally 5GSM cause IE.

entities.name: 5GSM cause IE
entities.description: Information element indicating the reason for PDU session release. Contains 5GSM cause values like #44, #45, #83, #84, #96.

entities.name: PTI IE
entities.description: Procedure transaction identifier IE set to an allocated PTI value not currently in use.

entities.name: Timer T3582
entities.description: Timer started when UE sends PDU SESSION RELEASE REQUEST. Stopped upon network-initiated release procedure or PDU SESSION RELEASE REJECT.

entities.name: Release due to errors or limits
entities.description: Condition where UE releases PDU session due to QoS/packet filter errors or reaching maximum supported QoS rules/packet filters/QoS flow descriptions.

entities.name: NAS transport procedure
entities.description: Procedure used to transport PDU SESSION RELEASE REQUEST message and PDU session ID as specified in subclause 5.4.5.

relations.description: UE-requested PDU session release procedure includes sending PDU SESSION RELEASE REQUEST message.
PDU SESSION RELEASE REQUEST message may contain 5GSM cause IE to indicate release reason.
PDU SESSION RELEASE REQUEST message contains PTI IE set to allocated PTI value.
UE starts timer T3582 when sending PDU SESSION RELEASE REQUEST message.
Condition of release due to errors or limits requires inclusion of 5GSM cause IE in PDU SESSION RELEASE REQUEST.
UE-requested PDU session release procedure uses NAS transport procedure to send message and PDU session ID.
